description: Configuration values for the MongoDB Helm chart

name.description: Service the alerts are attributed to. Defaults to the release name

version.description: MongoDB image tag (mongo:<version>). Moving to a new major version must go one major at a time, as MongoDB requires

diskSize.description: Size of the persistent volume backing /data/db. Cannot be changed after install

wiredTigerCacheSizeGB.description: WiredTiger cache size in GB, e.g. 0.25. Keep it well under the memory limit - mongod otherwise sizes the cache from the node's RAM

services.description: Databases to create, one user per entry

resources.description: CPU and memory requests and limits for the MongoDB container

nodeSelector.description: Node labels the pod must match, for pinning the workload to a node pool

tolerations.description: Taints the pod tolerates, so it can schedule onto a tainted node pool

affinity.description: Pod affinity / anti-affinity rules, applied verbatim to the pod spec
